notes.addresses: Unslid iOS 7.1.2 shared-cache VAs only. All entry/mid-function bytes verified against the supplied cache. Filter identity.process AND pid; SpringBoard restarted from PID38 to106 in probe96.
notes.correction: UIApplication _handleHIDEvent: at184911f3c is RET and only handles otherwise-unrecognized HID types. Digitizers use __UIApplicationHandleHIDEvent -> __UIApplicationHandleEventQueue directly. Its absence is expected.
notes.hid_client_dequeued: x0 is IOHIDEvent or NULL; x19 client. Event inline header: +10 u64 mach timestamp,+18 u64 sender,+64 u32 type,+68 flags. Dump x0:256. Callback-call x8 function, x3 event, x2 sender service (NULL service is passed, not dropped).
notes.ui_hid_callback: C callback: x3 IOHIDEvent; x0/x1 callback context, x2 service. Dump x3:256. ui_hid_enqueue: x0 NSMutableArray (nil means UIApp/event queue unavailable),x2 event,x3=0. ui_hid_signal:x0 CFRunLoopSource.
notes.ui_queue_count: x0 queue count before optional coalescing. Queue <3 proceeds directly; this is not a drop threshold.
notes.ui_queue_event: x0 oldest IOHIDEvent, soon moved to x28; NULL means empty. Coalescing may reduce counts without dropping lifecycle transitions.
notes.ui_touches_event_result: x0 chosen UIInternalEvent; zero goes to unknown-HID branch. Digitizer uses _touchesEvent; x28 HID event.
notes.ui_interaction_ignored: x0 result of isIgnoringInteractionEvents. If zero, lifecycle query runs and ui_lifecycle_ignored x0 is result; otherwise latter hook legitimately absent.
notes.ui_digitizer_children: x0 child count,x19 CFArray,x28 HID event. Parent mask is u64 at sp+138. This point is before _isSpringBoard special handling.
notes.ui_digitizer_status: x0 BKSHIDEventGetSystemGestureStatus result. At this PC bit7 of parent mask can bypass children loop. Dump sp+0x120:256 for count/mask/time/ignore flag.
notes.ui_window_context_result: x0 decoded BKS context ID (integer), soon x25. ui_window_context_compare:x0 window _contextId,x25 event context,x28 UIWindow. Fallback is attempted on zero/mismatch; context mismatch alone is not proof of a drop.
notes.ui_window_selected: x0 result of fallback _hitTestToPoint:pathIndex:forEvent:screen:,soon x27. This hook is fallback only; direct-context success skips it. Inspect later ui_touch_add_gate and dispatch gate too.
notes.ui_touch_add_gate: x0 ignore/eaten control,x1 UITouch,x2 delayed control,x3 UITouchesEvent. Unlike ui_add_touch, this sees touches rejected before _addTouch:forDelayedDelivery:.
notes.ui_dispatch_gate: x22 any touch to dispatch,x23 dismiss-callout flag,x28 UITouchesEvent; stack sp+1d0 u64 ignore/lifecycle flag. Dump sp+0x1c0:192: offset10 ignore; offset60 UIEvent; offset78 temporary touch-map. No send if ignored or x22=0. ui_send_from_queue is the actual objc sendEvent: call (x0 app,x2 event).
notes.bks_digitizer_info: x0 event,x1 u32 context ID,x2 system-gesture status,x3 state-change flag,x4 display CFString or NULL. x1=3f6dde0c is integer context, not a float. bks_event_info_result:x0 pointer to context(u32),flags(u8),padding,display-string length/data; dump x0:64.
notes.ca_context: ca_hit_test CGPoint is d0/d1 (raw HMP Q00/Q01 low64 interpreted double); ca_hit_context_result x19 context. ca_context_client/task x2 context ID. result x19 client port / x0 task port; ports are task-local names, not PIDs. Caller identity distinguishes backboardd (server) and SpringBoard.
notes.caps: Use --max-hits ui_=0 --max-hits hid_client_=0 --max-hits ca_=0 to retain startup and touch callbacks. 0 means unlimited. Other retained T5 factory/contact hooks can use cap200. HMP already saves raw Q registers; no extra SIMD reads necessary.
notes.limitations: No guest writes or method calls. A deserialized event alone proves neither application callback nor main-runloop dispatch. Full probe decision tree and stack layout are in T6 report.
notes.hid_connection_dispatch: Dump x0:184 (connection) and x1:256 (HID event). Verified connection fields: +60 u32 owning PID (__IOHIDEventSystemConnectionGetPID=1825e27ec),+a0 u32 client type,+b0 u32 task port,+20 queue pointer. This distinguishes routed application vs monitor connections. hid_connection_enqueue_result:x0 IOReturn,x20 connection,x19 queue; success=0.
notes.ui_window_hit_test: Class method: x2 path index,x3 UIEvent,x4 screen,d0/d1 point; returns through ui_window_selected only when called by this queue fallback. ui_window_context x0 UIWindow; compare its return at ui_window_context_compare. This does not identify the greeting window class without an object/class dump.
